verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is a SaaS compliance platform that could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only a REST API, a Postman collection, an OpenAPI schema, webhooks and the web app. Those are adjacent developer building blocks or other features, not an official command-line tool, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
